```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet">

  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.35 0.18 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.40 0.25 0.12 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Cabinet carcass. Link frame is at the floor, under the middle of the cabinet. -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="35.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="3.525" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="4.675" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.131"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.41 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.41 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Door. Link frame sits on the hinge axis at the front-left vertical edge. -->
  <link name="door">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5204" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.80145" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.28145"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Vertical hinge on the left front edge; positive joint value swings the door outward (-Y). -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.375 -0.215 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 -1"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="1.92" effort="15.0" velocity="1.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.5" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
